idea-plugin.name: Safe Project Close
idea-plugin.description:
Prevents accidental project-window closure in JetBrains Remote Development sessions.

When multiple projects are open on the same remote backend, closing a non-last project window may not trigger the IDE's built-in confirmation. This plugin displays a confirmation dialog with the project name, allowing you to close the project or cancel the operation.

Also works in regular IntelliJ Platform IDE windows. Supports Remote Development / Split Mode.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Confirm closing any non-last project window.
  • Support Remote Development / Split Mode.
  • Provide English and Simplified Chinese UI text.
